subtitle: Sovereign Core — Universal Data Vault & Connected Character Center
changes: Introduced Sovereign Data Vault: export and selectively restore planning data from eleven independent browser-local modules in a single versioned backup.
Added privacy-conscious backup previews, recognized-key allowlisting, size limits, restore confirmation and best-effort rollback on storage failure.
Added Connected Character Center with explicit opt-in import of public character selectors into Character Targets and Farming Operations.
Versioned the verified Battle.net Cloudflare Worker reference in the repository for recovery without exposing credentials or changing the live deployment.
Protected Farming Operations against malformed cross-tab storage updates and synchronized initial Battle.net account status across panels.
Reduced repetitive accessibility announcements from the verification timer while retaining short-lived server-validated status and expiration.
Organized the command launcher into Character, Collection, Progress, Account and utility groupings without removing existing tools.
Expanded automated validation to cover v4.0 modules, authentication boundaries, navigation and the preserved Worker verification routes.
